
{{alias}}( y, p )
    Computes the squared error loss.

    If any argument is `NaN`, the function returns `NaN`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    y: number
        True target value.

    p: number
        Predicted value.

    Returns
    -------
    v: number
        Squared error loss.

    Examples
    --------
    > var v = {{alias}}( -2.0, -1.782 )
    ~0.0238
    > v = {{alias}}( 0.202, 0.202 )
    0.0
    > v = {{alias}}( 1.0, -0.999 )
    ~1.998
    > v = {{alias}}( 0.2, 0.532 )
    ~0.0551
    > v = {{alias}}( NaN, 0.987 )
    NaN

    See Also
    --------
